label: Hemostasis: coagulation cascade and platelet activation
reason: Coagulation factors, VWF/GPIb defects, platelet receptor signalling and fibrinolysis are all hemostasis; IGFBP transport is a lone odd member.

label: Skeletal myogenesis and satellite-cell regeneration
reason: Myoblast proliferation, fusion, differentiation and satellite cell regeneration form one skeletal muscle development theme.

label: Adrenergic cAMP/PKA signalling and adenylate cyclase control
reason: Alpha-2 adrenergic/Gi inhibition of adenylate cyclase, cAMP synthesis/degradation and PKA activation are one second-messenger axis.

label: Gonadotropin control of gonadal and follicle function
reason: FSH/LH/GnRH, activin/follistatin, AMH, ovarian follicle, ovulation, luteinisation and Sertoli/Leydig biology are the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis.

label: Mitophagy, selective autophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
reason: PINK1-Parkin and receptor mitophagy, pexophagy/reticulophagy, autophagosome assembly and mitochondrial fission/fusion form mitochondrial quality control.

label: DNA double-strand break repair (HR, NHEJ, FA)
reason: BRCA1/2-PALB2 HR defects, NHEJ, SSA, MMEJ, Fanconi pathway and PARylation are all DSB repair.

label: Cell cycle: E2F, DNA replication, mitosis
reason: E2F/RB targets, origin licensing, APC/C, G2/M checkpoints and proliferation BTMs all describe cell-cycle progression.

label: Cell cycle: E2F, DNA replication, mitosis
reason: Same proliferation program: E2F/RB transcription, pre-replicative complex, G2/M transition and checkpoints.

label: MECP2 neuronal gene regulation and Rett-type behaviours
reason: MECP2 transcriptional control/Rett mutations linked to the sensory, motor and social behaviours disrupted in MECP2 disorders via neuronal gene regulation.

label: Chromatin remodelling complexes and histone acetylation
reason: BAF variants, CHD/NuRD, HATs and chromatin assembly dominate; a few odd members (N-terminal acetylation, centriole replication, organism emergence).

label: Cardiac ventricle and myocardium development
reason: Trabeculation, compact myocardium, second heart field and chamber morphogenesis are all heart development.

label: Nephron development and patterning
reason: Renal vesicle, comma/S-shaped body, tubule segments and collecting duct are nephrogenesis stages.

label: Bile acid synthesis, transport and signalling
reason: Bile acid synthesis routes, CYP8B1/CYP27A1, ABCB11/ABCB4 transport defects and LXR/FXR regulation are one bile acid theme.

label: Xenobiotic and toxin metabolism (phase I/II)
reason: CYP oxidation, sulfonation, acetylation, methylation, aflatoxin and paracetamol metabolism are drug/xenobiotic detoxification.

label: Glandular and reproductive organ development
reason: Mammary, prostate, pancreatic and gonad/genital development linked by glandular epithelial differentiation and branching morphogenesis, much of it sex-hormone dependent.

label: Cilium assembly, trafficking and motility
reason: IFT, BBSome, basal body, dynein arms, multiciliogenesis and sperm flagella; brain ventricle/CSF terms reflect ependymal cilia.

label: Type I interferon antiviral response
reason: IFN-alpha/beta signalling, ISG15, OAS, PKR and TREX1 are the type I IFN antiviral programme.

label: Coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis
reason: Contact activation (FXII/kallikrein), fibrin formation, plasminogen regulation and clot dissolution form plasma hemostasis.

label: Platelet GPCR activation via Rho/Rap signalling
reason: Thrombin/PAR, ADP P2Y, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors with G12/13-Rho and Rap1 signalling drive platelet activation.

label: Amino acid and oligopeptide membrane transport
reason: SLC6A19/SLC6A20/SLC36A2 amino acid transporters, Hartnup/iminoglycinuria and proton-peptide cotransporters; SLC22A18 is an odd member.

label: Peptide hormone GPCRs and appetite regulation
reason: Feeding/appetite control linked to Gs-cAMP peptide hormone receptors (amylin, calcitonin/CGRP, glucagon family, ghrelin) that mediate gut-brain satiety signals.

label: Antimicrobial peptides and innate antibacterial defence
reason: Alpha/beta defensins, metal sequestration, mucosal immunity and neutrophil killing of bacteria and fungi form one antimicrobial theme.

label: Arp2/3 actin protrusions: lamellipodia and ruffles
reason: WASP/WAVE, Arp2/3 nucleation, lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis are leading-edge actin dynamics.

label: DNA repair and replication stress response
reason: DSB repair, ICL repair, fork reversal, BRCA/PALB2 defects and genotoxin responses dominate; a few cell-division terms are minor.

label: Cholesterol homeostasis: SREBP and LDL receptor
reason: SREBP regulation, cholesterol biosynthesis control, LDLR/VLDLR uptake and LXR-limited uptake are sterol homeostasis.

label: PI3K-AKT-FOXO signalling and cell death
reason: AKT inactivation and nuclear exclusion of FOXO, FOXO-driven apoptosis/atrophy genes and IGF responses form one axis.

label: Histone/DNA methylation and chromatin regulation
reason: PKMTs, PRC2, KMT2D/WDR5, HDMs, DNA methylation, imprinting, X-inactivation and BAF/CHD remodelling are epigenetic chromatin control.

label: Branching epithelial organ development (kidney, lung, glands)
reason: Kidney, lung, mammary, prostate, salivary and pancreatic development share mesenchymal-epithelial (FGF10/FGFR2b) branching morphogenesis.

label: Cell cycle: E2F and G2/M progression
reason: E2F targets, G1/S transcription, cyclin B/PLK G2/M events and proliferation BTMs are one cell-cycle theme.

label: Complement and antimicrobial innate humoral defence
reason: Complement cascade and neutrophil granule/antimicrobial peptide defence linked by shared role in opsonising and killing bacteria/fungi.

label: TCA cycle and lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases
reason: PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes, DLD, lipoylation, Fe-S cluster assembly for TCA enzymes and succinate oxidation are mitochondrial oxidative metabolism.

label: Cardiac conduction and action potential
reason: AV node, His-Purkinje signalling, phase 0 depolarisation and gap junction coupling are cardiac electrical conduction.

label: ERBB/PTK6 signalling and receptor endocytic downregulation
reason: PTK6 signalling downstream of ERBB2 linked to ubiquitin/endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB receptors, both governing ERBB signal output.

label: MAPK cascade activation and phosphatase feedback
reason: ERK/JNK/p38/ERK5 activation, DUSP dephosphorylation and AP-1 output form MAPK regulation; IL-6/STAT3 terms are a small minority.

label: Skeletal myogenesis and muscle regeneration
reason: Myoblast commitment, proliferation, fusion and satellite cell activation are skeletal muscle development.

label: T cell adhesion and immunological synapse
reason: Lymphocyte aggregation, rafts, T cell polarity, synapse formation and leukocyte adhesion describe T cell contact formation.

label: M-CSF/GM-CSF myeloid and osteoclast differentiation
reason: CSF1 signalling drives macrophage/monocyte differentiation and osteoclastogenesis (a myeloid lineage), plus bone resorption control.

label: Germline epigenetics, piRNA silencing and maternal-zygotic transition
reason: piRNA/KRAB/HUSH transposon silencing, imprinting, spermatogenesis and MZT/ZGA linked by germline-to-zygote epigenetic reprogramming; a few odd members.

label: Cilia, sperm flagella and photoreceptor connecting cilium
reason: IFT, basal body, dynein arms, sperm axoneme and photoreceptor outer segment (a modified cilium) are ciliary biology.

label: Embryonic heart and cardiac mesoderm development
reason: Mesoderm specification, second heart field, heart tube, pericardium and coronary vasculogenesis are early heart development.
